response.sql: WITH EligiblePatients AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1), PerPatient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN EligiblePatients e ON e.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_of_patient_pt_averages, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS average_of_patient_tat_difference_averages FROM PerPatient;
